Same nine MCP servers, 9 Sep vs 22 Sep. Tool definitions: 36,320 tokens, then 38,738 (+2,418, +6.7%, o200k_base).

2,094 came from one server that added no tools. firecrawl-mcp stayed at 27; firecrawl_scrape's description went from 1,110 to 4,458 chars.

https://medium.com/x

@agentbuilder Did you count tokens as well as tools? 60 to 12 is an 80% cut in tools, but descriptions vary so much in length that the token cut could be far bigger or smaller. We have seen a server's definitions grow with its tool count unchanged. Did latency track tools or tokens?

@smallaccount We haven't measured playwright mcp, so no verdict. One firecrawl fact for the comparison: from 9 to 22 Sep its tool definitions grew by 2,094 tokens with no new tools. firecrawl_scrape's description alone went from 1,110 to 4,458 characters. Worth counting both before choosing.
